audit.why: Azir E (Shifting Sands) is 22s at rank 1 with a shield — the defining window. Q is 14s early falling to 6s. R (Emperor's Divide, 120s) knocks back and creates terrain, flipping Naafiri's W/R dashes. Naafiri Q is a projectile; Azir has no projectile block, only body-block via soldiers is irrelevant (soldiers are not units).

edits.before: Q-Q the bleed-consume on his last hits — the double dagger chunks harder than the lobby expects at one.
edits.after: Q-Q the bleed-consume on his last hits — his lone soldier hits soft and the double dagger chunks him.

edits.before: Pack pressure begins: hounds chase what you Q — trade where the dogs can pile on.
edits.after: Hounds chase whatever you Q — pile the pack on before he stacks two soldiers.

edits.before: W online: the lock-on dive threatens anyone past the wave's midline. The lane plays scared now.
edits.after: W online: the lock-on dive threatens Azir every time he steps up to a soldier for last hits.

edits.before: Q-E strings on every contact — the pack heals you through trades and the bleed math compounds.
edits.after: Q-E strings on every step-up — the pack heals through trades while his 14s Q gates his answer.

edits.before: R online: the vision sweep plus bigger pack makes every roam a scheduled accident for a side lane.
edits.after: R online: dive through the soldier zone before he can Emperor's Divide-flip you back out of it.

edits.before: First item spike: the W dive plus full string deletes squishies. Hunt the half-bars.
edits.after: First item spike: the full string one-combos him the moment he steps up to farm.

edits.before: Late Naafiri flanks: R the sweep, W the carry, and let the pack vote on the peel.
edits.after: Two items in, his range and R wall kite your dash — Azir dictates the fights now.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Eviscerate has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — a 22s cooldown at rank 1 shield-dash; the window after he burns it is your all-in. - His Q runs 14s early, 6s maxed — poke gaps close as he levels. - Your E (11s) is the escape; your R (110s) is the kill call.

edits.before: Q the bleed, Q the consume, E through with the pack piling — a six-body trade he answered with one rotation.
edits.after: First dagger applies the bleed, second consumes it for bonus damage — land both on him, not on the soldiers.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: Shoved past river with Shifting Sands up, his shield-dash escapes ganks and his soldiers poke you for free.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Azir wins by kiting behind soldiers, E-shielding your W dive, and R-flipping the all-in you saved for him.

edits.before: You are the flank with a head count: R the approach, W through the front line, and let the hounds peel-proof the exit.
edits.after: Flank Azir's backline: his R wall stops a front-door W, so come from the side after Emperor's Divide is spent.
